The AI Operator reviews each exact fresh RouteIntent candidate and decides APPROVE or STAND_DOWN and, when approving, controls lot size by selecting one exact sizing_ref from broker-valid PROBE, STANDARD, PRESS_EDGE, and MAX_WITHIN_ENVELOPE choices. Those choices are calculated from stop risk, equity, free margin, margin utilization, portfolio exposure, broker minimum, maximum and lot step, and owner caps. Exact scale_in drafts are first-class discretionary actions. They are generated only for a fresh, protected parent whose open P&L is net positive after every currently reported swap, carry, and commission amount; each sizing option is broker-grid valid and carries current stop risk, margin, parent ticket, unit index, sizing_ref, and sizing-plan hash. The Operator may select one add without per-add human confirmation. Its short-lived authorization is account/config/parent/order bound and one-shot. A pre-cost winner that is net losing after reported costs, stale parent, changed parent volume or protective geometry, reused authorization, cap breach, or unrecognized sizing_ref blocks before broker touch. Current quote, open-P&L, cost, account, position, candidate, guidance, control, and outcome evidence are bound into the decision cache identity. If any bound evidence changes, the old model decision is not reused and a fresh immediate position decision is required. Every management cycle preserves scale-in status, broker-grid option count, qualified-parent count, max compound units, minimum profit R, and each binding parent/risk/margin/exposure/position-cap blocker through dispatch status, Operator chat, and the Operator dropdown. Baseline stop/target installation and high-urgency invalidation exits are non-vetoable policy actions. Every selected action still passes through order_dispatch.py, execution_guard.py, fresh broker truth, terminal permissions, duplicate suppression, and receipt reconciliation.

Every broker position with a protective stop exposes broker-valued entry-to-current-stop risk, remaining current-equity drawdown to the stop, the current per-trade cap, and any cap breach to the MT5 UI, ordinary Operator chat, and immediate Operator position management. This evidence does not itself force-close an already-open trade.

A nonzero stale MT5 bid or ask must not keep the app labeled MARKET OPEN. Weekend, post-Friday-close, disabled-symbol, materially future, and stale tick evidence must fail closed. Protected open positions remain visible and supervised as WATCHING_MARKET_CLOSED while broker-side stops and targets remain in force; no fresh management action may be dispatched until executable quote truth returns.

The standard forex week reopens at Sunday 22:00 UTC and remains open until Friday 22:00 UTC unless symbol-specific broker truth says otherwise. CAS must distinguish account-snapshot observation age from each instrument's terminal tick age. A fresh account read never turns a stale or unavailable market tick into fresh price evidence, and Sunday reopen may not be forced closed by a Monday-through-Friday-only calendar shortcut.

The AI Operator owns an owner-fenced entry-timeframe dial. The autonomous scheduler rotates the enabled completed-candle lanes rather than silently fixing entries to one timeframe: M1 and M5 are the micro-scalp lane, while M15 and H1 are the broader intraday lane. Changing the dial changes which lanes may form candidates; it never bypasses edge, risk, quote, duplicate, recovery, execution-guard, or kill-switch requirements.

Candidate formation is part of the Operator's mandatory decision-grade evidence, not an opaque pre-model filter. Every full market scan preserves the raw directional score, configured directional floor, margin to that floor, candidate-formation status, edge-test status, strongest rejected lane, the best statistically passing below-floor lane, and per-timeframe attempt counts. A below-floor shadow edge evaluation is read-only: it may estimate the same completed-candle candidate at an in-memory admission floor of zero, but it must not mint or retain an edge token, register an authorization, form a RouteIntent, touch a broker, or send an order. The best shadow-PASS lane is tracked separately from the strongest directional score because those can be different lanes. A scheduler invocation skipped by a live-candle cache must report SCAN_THROTTLED_CACHE with fresh_market_scan_performed=false; it may never be labeled or interpreted as a completed scan or as proof that the market lacked opportunity. When repeated fresh PAPER/DEMO scans show every observed lane below the current directional floor, the scheduled AI Operator must inspect the strongest rejected score, owner bounds, paper-learning state, and independent outcome evidence before choosing one small owner-fenced adjustment or an explicit evidence-based STAND_DOWN. A hold response that omits the exact strongest score, current floor, and evidence-based stand-down reason is incomplete. Candidate starvation uses a focused entry-opportunity model request before broad portfolio commentary, followed by one focused repair attempt when needed. If both model responses remain contract-invalid, a deterministic continuation policy may lower only the PAPER admission floor to the exact best shadow-PASS score when paper learning is active, MT5Bridge is demonstrably order-send ready, the preview is unregistered and tokenless, owner bounds permit the change, and every other stated prerequisite passes. A lower floor admits candidates for fresh edge testing and learning; it is not itself proof of edge, profitability, or order authority. Every admitted candidate still requires a new full edge evaluation, fresh one-shot authorization, risk feasibility, immediate Operator approval, quote, duplicate, recovery, execution-guard, and kill-switch gates before dispatch.

Repeated cross-market candidates blocked only because the ordinary concurrent-position cap is full must remain durable Operator evidence when separate lot-exposure utilization is low. Three or more cap-only events across at least two symbols inside the bounded evidence window require one focused scheduled Operator decision whenever no explicit owner override fixes the cap and the owner envelope permits one additional slot. The Operator may either add exactly one concurrent-position slot or return an explicit evidence-based STAND_DOWN that cites the current cap, event count, exposure utilization, and a portfolio, correlation, outcome, expectancy, edge, or risk reason. It may not jump multiple slots, infer order authority from spare capacity, or use the daily target deficit as justification. A contract-invalid local-model reply may fall back only to the same bounded one-slot policy in PAPER or DEMO. Immediately before applying any widening, CAS must refresh the active MT5 account and position snapshot and prove the cap is still full, exposure remains at or below 25 percent of its separate owner-fenced ceiling, and the exact one-slot recommendation is still valid. If positions have closed or state changed, the adjustment is skipped and pressure is cleared. Every later candidate still requires fresh ordinary edge, sizing, risk, quote, duplicate, recovery, execution-guard, and kill-switch gates plus immediate entry-Operator approval before broker touch.

Micro-scalp execution must be formed from current completed M1 or M5 broker candles, current bid/ask truth, and a direction derived from current market state. Historical replay templates, hard-coded LONG or SHORT direction, and default midpoint prices are research inputs only and cannot enter the broker-bound RouteIntent collector. Every fresh scalp candidate still requires immediate AI Operator APPROVE or STAND_DOWN before guarded dispatch.

Current quote truth is checked before a completed-candle candidate records or consumes its one-shot route identity. A missing, closed, unusable, stale, or materially future-dated quote produces no executable candidate and no emission key, so a weekend scan cannot waste the setup identity that may be valid after the market reopens.

A blocked PASS cannot monopolize a timeframe, hide an actionable alternative, or be represented as an executable opportunity. Completed-candle normalization runs before edge preview, duplicate checks, and actionability ranking. Public-launch, legal-review, or live-license state does not by itself block paper or demo execution and must not be presented as the paper/demo blocker unless runtime evidence says that gate actually fired.

Observation-only chart and MT5 refresh work must not block the API event loop or the shared Operator-chat worker pool. Slow chart/provider work runs through an isolated bounded one-flight worker and returns stale or timeout telemetry without silencing normal Operator Ask traffic.

A timed-out model cannot leave the owner without a response or falsely report a running dispatch thread as stopped. When a paid model key and remaining budget are available, free-form Assistant and Operator questions must run off the API event loop and return the real model answer inside explicit response budgets. Configuration status must distinguish a configured key from provider reachability, and a finite budget from an exhausted budget. A current trade-inactivity or scalp question must answer immediately from the same rich completed-cycle dispatch snapshot shown in the cockpit, overlaid with the newest lock-free heartbeat. When no rich cycle exists yet after startup, the answer must call that telemetry warm-up rather than inventing prudence, a model stand-down, or a market blocker. READY requires a fresh successful generation request. Positive response-status questions return grounded runtime truth and cannot invent broad all-systems-green claims. Operator context percentage fields are expressed in percentage points, not decimal fractions. A value of 0.1 means 0.1%, never 10%. Chat and scheduled reasoning must receive this convention plus human-readable risk labels so the model cannot silently multiply a risk cap by 100 in owner-facing prose.

When enabled, trailing_lock_fraction determines the exact lock fraction and is retained in decision parameters and audit evidence. No hard-coded exit constant may silently override the Operator or owner control surface.

Critical-notification audit rows are immutable history, but transient blocked attempts must not appear forever as current active conditions. The in-app strip uses explicit display TTL and ACTIVE versus EXPIRED_HISTORICAL state. Expiry changes only presentation; it never deletes or rewrites the underlying audit event.
Quote age is rechecked at broker-touch time after AI deliberation. A stale or materially future-dated attached market quote blocks dispatch even when the Operator approved the candidate earlier.

New-entry symbol filtering must occur before route ranking. The owner-fenced AI symbol dial defines the base universe; an optional scheduler subset may narrow it, and per-symbol position caps remove saturated markets from new entries only. Existing saturated positions remain under autonomous management. Targeting provenance, effective symbols, eligible symbols, and saturation reasons must be visible and durably audited.

A positively identified demo account is PAPER_MT5 in the MT5_DEMO_BROKER lane and must not consume live-pilot capacity. Historical misclassifications are corrected by immutable appended evidence; original records are not rewritten.

Every closed CAS MT5 demo position must join the originating AI decision and finalized order attempt by exact broker position ticket. The join retains decision_ref, order_id, strategy, direction, timeframe, gross profit, commission, swap, close reason, and normalized broker timestamps. Repeated syncs are idempotent. A history read with zero identity matches must be reported as unbound, not as completed learning.

Recovery is idempotent, remains visible cumulatively, and never sends or retries an order. Ambiguous or live-money attempts remain blocked for explicit recovery.
A fresh one-shot edge authorization is consumed where configured. If the owner disables that requirement for a strategy, risk and broker gates still apply.
Risk caps apply to paper and live. Within armed live mode, the AI may trade autonomously up to the owner-configured caps. Owner override wins, then AI dial, then config.

A positive daily_loss_cap_usd is a hard new-exposure boundary measured from reconciled broker realized P&L for the current UTC day. Once realized P&L is at or below the negative cap, every new entry and scale-in is blocked in paper, demo, and live operation regardless of model output, provider failure, degraded paper fallback, upstream approval, or stale PASS. An active cap fails closed when reconciled daily realized truth is unavailable. Protective stop/target modification, take-profit, partial close, full close, and other proven risk-reducing management remain available. Zero disables this cap. The immediate Operator stage checks it before spending a model call, and execution_guard.py checks it again immediately before broker touch. Cached daily realized truth is valid only when its UTC day equals the current UTC day. UTC rollover forces an immediate account-growth refresh and resets the day window. Current-history latest-deal fingerprints are compared even when the account balance is unchanged, preventing an offsetting deposit or other same-balance deal sequence from hiding a new realized loss. A stale period blocks new exposure until fresh reconciled truth exists.

Only explicit owner risk-control overrides are durable authority. They are atomically persisted before becoming active and survive API restarts, including an explicit null meaning unlimited. An absent override key leaves that dimension under AI-dial then static-config precedence. Owner-editing values, persisted override identity, and effective dispatch caps must be reported as separate layers. Preview, confirmation, cooldown, and journal posture are calculated from the before/after effective dispatch caps, not from a static fallback that the Operator dial already supersedes.

Every overseer-approved entry candidate is valued against current broker tick economics, account equity, stop geometry, minimum lot, and lot step before an AI Operator model call. A candidate that exceeds the per-trade cap even at the broker minimum lot is blocked as BLOCKED_AT_BROKER_MIN_LOT and consumes no Operator decision. A candidate that can comply at one or more broker-grid sizes receives an exact sizing plan containing only currently supportable choices. The AI Operator, not a fixed 0.01-lot constant, selects one supplied sizing_ref when it approves the entry. The model cannot invent volume and the preflight cannot approve or dispatch an order. Unknown estimates remain explicitly unknown and may expose only the conservative seed/floor until the authoritative final execution guard recalculates the selected size at broker touch. If all fresh candidates or qualified scale-in parents have zero broker-grid options, runtime and chat must name every binding cap. The Operator may make a small owner-fenced dial adjustment only when after-cost evidence supports sustainable growth; otherwise it rotates to viable conditions or stands down rather than forcing activity.

Learning readiness is evaluated per symbol x direction x profile group. An overall count that reaches the sample threshold does not make grouped adaptation ready when those outcomes are scattered across unrelated groups. Runtime evidence exposes overall_sample_ready, group_learning_ready, and learning_ready_group_count separately.

The connected broker account and open positions are authoritative from the current MT5 terminal snapshot. Current entry and position-management execution state is authoritative from the active dispatch loop. Separate movement-stream supervision, simulator-ledger account health, live-readiness monitoring, and durable auto-halt evidence retain their own scopes but may not override the active primary MT5 PAPER or LIVE lane. force_paper_mode blocks live escalation rather than PAPER or DEMO execution. Contradictory source states must be exposed as conflicts and may not become durable Operator lessons.
Owner arming of live and money switches grants standing authority. Arming does not itself place a trade, but once armed the AI may place trades without per-trade confirmation when gates pass.
Fresh broker account, balance, equity, margin, position, and open-order truth is required before live dispatch. Stale truth blocks dispatch.

The account governed by the active execution lane is the owner and Operator source of truth. When PAPER dispatch is running through a connected MT5 demo bridge, the current MT5 account snapshot, balance, equity, open positions, protection, and risk outrank an exported verifier, movement stream, or separate simulator ledger. Secondary ledgers remain visible only under an explicit non-authoritative label and are never added to MT5 money or P&L.

Account growth and open P&L are measured after reported trading costs. The cockpit separately exposes price P&L, swap or carry, commission when known, and net open P&L. The same active-account decomposition is mandatory in immediate entry, position-management, scale-in, and time-stop reasoning; a positive price subtotal cannot authorize compounding while reported costs make the position net negative. A current balance is not called profit without a reconciled deposit, withdrawal, transfer, fee, and realized-outcome baseline.

The north-star realized-growth baseline comes from the authoritative full MT5 deal ledger queried from before the first effective account event through the current broker snapshot. Every deal contributes profit, commission, swap, and fee to the ledger. Balance deposits, withdrawals, credit, and bonuses are classified as capital flow rather than trading profit. CAS may report cashflow-adjusted realized growth only when the history belongs to the selected account, the first effective event establishes opening capital, every deal type is understood, the ledger ties to current balance within account-currency rounding, and the growth components tie. Unknown deal types, incomplete opening history, a stale or different account, or any unexplained residual makes realized growth unavailable. Open P&L stays separate and unrealized.

Realized learning evidence is ordered by authoritative broker close time and grouped by exact symbol, timeframe, direction, and profile or strategy. Every autonomous execution receipt and opening memory row preserves the candidate's opening market regime, and each exact behavior group is then split into regime-comparable outcome groups. Pooled all-regime evidence remains visible as context, but it cannot authorize PRESS_EDGE, MAX_WITHIN_ENVELOPE, or adaptation promotion. At least one known-regime subgroup must independently meet the sample, after-cost, risk-normalization, and single-best-outcome robustness requirements. Legacy or unattributed UNKNOWN-regime outcomes remain learning context and cannot by themselves justify larger sizing or promotion. Groups rank first by after-cost R expectancy using broker-valued admission stop risk, then by lot-normalized after-cost expectancy, raw after-cost expectancy, and actual net P&L. Actual net dollars remain the account scoreboard; R removes cross-instrument contract and stop-distance distortion, while per-lot normalization removes historical volume distortion inside a comparable instrument. Win rate is supporting evidence only. Profit from another group cannot subsidize or promote an unprofitable group. Adaptation promotion requires complete risk-normalized evidence and the exact promoted group to meet its own sample threshold and remain positive after commission, swap, fees, and realized losses in R, raw dollars, and per lot when available. A positive exact group is not robust press-size or promotion evidence when removing its single best realized outcome makes the remaining group non-positive. CAS records the removed ticket, leave-one-best-out net P&L and after-cost R expectancy, largest-win concentration, recent-window growth, and consecutive-loss count. An outlier-dependent group remains available to autonomous PAPER minimum, PROBE, or STANDARD learning judgment, but it cannot authorize PRESS_EDGE, MAX_WITHIN_ENVELOPE, or adaptation promotion until the exact group's after-cost growth survives the single-best-outcome test.

Learning, promotion, Operator candidate evidence, per-symbol exposure caps, and scale-in exposure must compare every supported broker alias through the canonical CAS instrument map. NAS100, USTEC, US100, and supported suffix variants are one market identity; the same rule applies to every configured alias family. Observed broker spellings remain visible for provenance. Unknown symbols retain an isolated normalized identity and are never silently merged into a supported instrument.

Operator status, dashboard polling, and chart-window reads are observational control-plane surfaces. Slow broker IPC, provider data, account ledgers, or readiness reports must refresh through bounded single-flight cache lanes and must not hold the Operator scheduler lock, monopolize the shared dashboard refresh queue, or make chat and execution status unreachable. Every cached or warming packet exposes age, freshness, and refresh state; stale evidence is never silently represented as fresh broker truth for dispatch.

Entry and position-management inference must run through bounded single-flight decision lanes so a slow or abandoned model request cannot block broker reconciliation, position protection, the dispatch scheduler, or owner chat. A lane permits at most one unfinished request. A result that completes after its wall-clock deadline may be delivered exactly once to the same decision kind, with its original request fingerprint retained; entry output cannot be delivered as position-management output or vice versa. Before any late result can affect an account, current action references, broker truth, mode, and every risk and execution gate must be revalidated. Selected, installed, or configured model state is not READY until a fresh real generation succeeds. Exact provider failures, including RAM or VRAM capacity errors, remain visible and auditable. Compact prompt transport may reduce model context, but it never replaces the full hash-bound decision evidence.

Closed-outcome learning recomputes planned stop risk from the immutable entry, stop, executed lot, broker tick size, and broker loss tick value before using a stored pre-trade risk field. The original stored value remains visible. Any material residual or ratio mismatch is counted and audited; stale estimates produced by older tick-conversion code cannot become learning or promotion authority. A legacy MT5 demo row that predates saved tick-contract fields may recover admission risk only when MT5 history proves an exact broker-side stop loss: the close reason identifies stop loss, close price equals the intended stop, entry/stop direction geometry is valid, volume is known, and broker gross P&L is negative. CAS uses the absolute broker gross stop-fill loss, excludes commission from the reconstructed stop risk, records the ticket and evidence, and leaves approximate, non-stop, profitable, simulator, or ambiguous closes incomplete.

An Operator APPROVE with broker-valid sizing options must identify one exact supplied sizing_ref. LOW, MEDIUM, or HIGH conviction is explanatory context, not a substitute lot-size instruction and cannot be silently mapped to PROBE, STANDARD, PRESS_EDGE, or MAX_WITHIN_ENVELOPE. Each option carries exact-group sample state and a historical after-cost projection. When risk evidence is complete, projection equals exact-group after-cost R expectancy times the option's current broker-valued stop risk. Per-lot projection is an explicitly non-comparable fallback only. Every projection is evidence, never a promised forward profit.

Position-management prompts recover the originating strategy and timeframe from the durable executed-order ledger when available. Every close, partial, reduce, modify, hold, or scale-in draft states its immediate realization effect using net open P&L after currently reported carry and commission. Future exit commission, slippage, and fill uncertainty remain explicitly unmodeled. The prompt positively instructs after-cost ranking and may not negate that rule. Current R and every scale-in threshold comparison use immutable original entry-to-stop risk recovered from the executed order receipt; moving the current stop to breakeven or profit does not manufacture 1.0R. A realization-only close below the scale-in horizon requires an explicit machine-checkable growth case. SELECT-close paired with HOLD rationale or summary is a binding-contract failure and leaves the position unchanged.

Every Operator-selected entry, close, partial close, stop change, target change, trail, or scale-in carries the actual decision provider, model, backend, prompt version and hashes, decision-context hash, exact candidate, sizing, or action reference, rationale, growth case, and Operator event hash into order dispatch and the durable broker-effect receipt. Static configured model names may remain visible as configuration but may not replace or be reported as the model that actually made the decision.

Every ordinary Operator conversation receives a non-optional priority account block before compressible supporting context. It identifies the account governed by the active execution lane, current balance, equity, positions, price P&L, swap or carry, commission, net open P&L after reported costs, baseline availability, and the separate status of simulator and replay evidence. Context compaction may summarize other evidence but may not remove or contradict this block. Fast owner chat declares its narrower explanation-only required-section profile; scheduled autonomous reasoning retains the full learning and adaptation profile.
The AI may create, modify, trail, and execute take-profit logic as a first-class trading action. Take-profit is part of autonomous position management, not a human-only step.

The AI may initiate deposits, withdrawals, payouts, and internal transfers through configured provider rails, owner-enabled capabilities, destination allowlists, transfer caps, and receipt logging. Sandbox and live provider environments must be explicit; sandbox proof cannot authorize or claim external money movement.
FOMO, revenge, martingale or gambler loops, and post-loss risk loosening become explicit dials, caps, cooldowns, and telemetry warnings. They do not convert the product into advisory-only mode.

Sustainable realized net account growth after spread, commission, swap, slippage, and losses is the north-star objective. Equity, drawdown, open risk, and margin are leading constraints on whether that growth can continue. Evidence quality must distinguish real signal from duplicated or correlated trades, luck clustering, and overfit strategy behavior. A daily target deficit, recent loss, winning streak, or desire for activity cannot by itself increase size or force a trade; those behaviors undermine the long-run growth objective.

The desk rotates among four camera speeds instead of staring through one lens.

Checking whether the smallest available shoe fits before asking the decision desk to approve wearing it.

Four observations in four different experiments do not become four repetitions of one experiment.

One symbol, timeframe, direction, and profile or strategy evaluated as its own learning unit.

Compare two recipes using the same serving size, while the cash register still records the actual meals sold.

Score every play in units of what was put at stake, even when stadiums and ticket prices differ.
Average realized after-cost R inside one exact behavior group; the primary comparable strategy-quality rank across instruments.
Average points earned per one unit staked, before checking the actual cash scoreboard.
A material difference between the immutable broker-contract reconstruction and the original stored pre-trade risk estimate; the original receipt remains unchanged.
A calculator correction attached beside an old invoice, not erasing the invoice.

The supervisor sees what goes into the bank now, what stays on the table, and which final bill is not known yet.
Current favorable movement divided by the immutable distance from original entry to original protective stop recovered from the executed order receipt.

The supervisor must name the concrete business reason for shutting a promising job early; collecting a few cents alone is not enough.
The provider, model, backend, prompt and context hashes, exact candidate/size/action, rationale, growth case, and event hash that actually produced a broker-bound effect.
The signed work order names the person and exact instruction that authorized the job, not merely who was scheduled for the shift.
The shared active-account and per-position after-cost truth supplied to immediate entry, position-management, scale-in, and time-stop decisions.
One official scoreboard on every decision desk, so no desk acts on a prettier subtotal.
A completed-candle setup key recorded only after current quote truth passes, preventing duplicate submissions.
A numbered ticket printed only when the venue is actually open.
Immediate AI selection of one exact broker-valid management action or STAND_DOWN.
The trade supervisor chooses among prepared, executable management moves.
An exact additional position unit offered only while the parent is fresh, protected, net profitable after reported carry/costs, and inside every current cap.
Adding a measured second engine only after the first is running well after its bill and all gauges are green.
